closed_set_safeguard.alternative: ArcFace known-test macro-F1 no more than 0.01 absolute below matched CE
closed_set_safeguard.primary: every ArcFace run has known-test macro-F1 >= 0.9616

confidence_interval.method: t-based 95% CI over seed-level matched deltas

decision_rule: ArcFace becomes the proposed primary method only if criteria A, C, D, and E pass; criterion B strengthens the claim but is not strictly mandatory if AUROC evidence is strong.

progression_criteria.criterion_a: Across V1 matched seed pairs, mean Delta AUROC >= +0.015 and t-based 95% CI excludes 0 favorably.
progression_criteria.criterion_b: Across V1 matched seed pairs, mean Delta FPR95 <= -0.075 and t-based 95% CI excludes 0 favorably.
progression_criteria.criterion_c: At least 4 of 5 V1 seeds have Delta AUROC > 0 for ArcFace + MSP versus CE + MSP.
progression_criteria.criterion_d: V2 mean Delta AUROC >= -0.01 and at least 3 of 5 V2 seeds have Delta AUROC >= 0.
progression_criteria.criterion_e: Every ArcFace run has macro-F1 >= 0.9616, or no ArcFace run is more than 0.01 absolute below matched CE.

unknown_usage: unknown test samples are evaluation and analysis only; they never influence training, checkpoint selection, threshold fitting, ViM fitting, or method selection
